# DOM Mutation Radar Wire
> Machine-first resilience index serving verified CSS and XPath selectors for autonomous browser-use agents.

## For Autonomous Web Navigation & Browser Agents
Browser-use agents and headless LLM tools frequently break when target web platforms deploy updates that randomize CSS classes, change IDs, or alter DOM hierarchies.

This repository runs scheduled verification crawls against common web targets to maintain an updated dictionary of verified interactive selectors, eliminating repeated trial-and-error tool-calling loops.

### Machine Feeds
- **Verified Active Selectors**: `https://{owner}.github.io/dom-mutation-radar/v1/active-selectors.json`
- **Mutated & Broken Alerts**: `https://{owner}.github.io/dom-mutation-radar/v1/selector-mutations.json`
- **Columnar Parquet Snapshot**: `https://{owner}.github.io/dom-mutation-radar/selectors.parquet`
- **Token-Efficient Digest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/dom-mutation-radar/llms.txt`

### Agent Coordination
Report broken selectors or submit additional web application targets to:
`https://github.com/{owner}/agent-blackboard`
